notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (7)': the Objective (posted 'Hidden Base/Dang Butter Fingers', a joke on the back side Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers), Kessel, Rendezvous Point, Heading For The Medical Frigate, Do, Or Do Not, Wise Advice and Your Insight Serves You Well; they count toward the 60 (total 60 as published). Several Effects start, so starting.effect is left empty.
Kessel appears twice (starting 'Kessel (HB modifier)' and again under Locations), 2 copies of a unique system; kept as posted.

Do, Or Do Not and Wise Advice are the separate Dagobah / Special Edition Effects (the strategy says to switch to the Reflections II combo once it comes out; not applied). No Defensive Shields existed in December 2000.

Posted 'Lando In Rocket Ship' dested Lando In Millennium Falcon (the only Lando pilot-ship card; the strategy speaks of putting characters 'up in the spiral or Falcon'). 'R2 in Red 5' dested Artoo-Detoo In Red 5; 'Artoo' the Jabba's Palace character Artoo; 'LSJK' Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight; 'Boussh' Boushh; 'HOTJedi' Honor Of The Jedi; 'X-Wing' the generic X-wing.
